Mother Of Thousands/Alligator Plant - 2x Mini Plugs - Succulent 
The Mother of Thousands or Alligator Plant is a type of succulent from the Kalanchoe genus, perfect for indoor houseplants. With a preference for summer and full sun, this green plant thrives with light watering. Originating from the United Kingdom, these mini plugs are ideal for adding a touch of nature to any indoor space, whether for decoration or to improve air quality.
